question: What expiation is required for transgressing an oath even by mistake?
premises: An oath may be transgressed unintentionally.
A twelve-day observance on grains is prescribed.
inference: Even if transgressed by mistake, one must observe twelve days subsisting on grains.
uncertainties: The full expiatory procedure may continue in adjacent verses.
plain_english: Even having transgressed it by mistake, one must observe twelve days subsisting on grains.
